moments.selftext: What is happening with the US job market? US job openings for June were revised down by -177,000 vacancies, their largest monthly downward revision since November 2025. This also marks the 3rd consecutive monthly downward revision. Furthermore, the number of hires for June was revised down by -16,000, while the number of quits was revised lower by -19,000. At the same time, the number of layoffs and discharges was revised up by +19,000. As a result, job openings have now been revised down in 38 of the last 43 months. US labor market data is becoming increasingly difficult to read with confidence.

moments.selftext: China just had its best earnings season in years: Profits at Chinese companies listed in mainland China surged +25.7% YoY in Q2 2026, the highest growth rate since Q2 2021. This also marks the 2nd consecutive quarter of positive earnings growth following a double-digit decline in Q4 2025. The surge was driven by AI-linked companies, with earnings up +42% on Shenzhen’s growth-focused ChiNext market and +370% on Shanghai’s technology-focused STAR Market, significantly outpacing the broader market. Despite this outstanding performance, the CSI 300 Index has fallen -9% so far this quarter, while the tech-heavy STAR 50 Index has dropped -29%. China is experiencing a historic earnings boom due to AI.

moments.selftext: My girlfriend and I attended the Ed Sheeran concert last evening in our company suite at MetLife with a number of guests; 34 to be exact (36 total attendees). I am not Jewish, however some of my guests are Jewish. I have never been more embarrassed, and shocked in my entire life. @macklemore is a complete clown for pulling the nonsense he pulled at BOTH “Ed Sheeran” concerts (Friday & Saturday evening). I have always been a Macklemore fan, but after his political stunt, I cannot support him or his music any longer. When you go WOKE, you have to be prepared to lose fans. After it happened on Friday, it should have immediately been stopped. This antisemitic behavior reflects so poorly on you @edsheeran . Very sadly you were complicit in allowing it to continue on Saturday evening. When I go to a concert, I am going to hear amazing music. I am NOT going to hear “Free Palestine” rants. Macklemore spread anti-Zionist, and antisemitic propaganda. He also accused Israel of committing genocide in Gaza. What does any of this have to do with music ? Why do I need to hear this BS at a concert that I’m supposedly going to, to hear amazing music ? If Macklemore feels so strongly about Palestine, then maybe he should donate all of his tour earnings to them ? You were sensational Ed. You seem like such an amazing individual; someone so cool and down to earth. Someone that I would love to actually hang out with. It’s a shame that you would allow someone else’s performance to tarnish your amazing image. I just don’t get it. I saw this same nonsense a few years ago when @U2 , who I happen love, were trying to compare Michelle Obama to Harriet Tubman, and other notable women of African American descent. Why can’t music be about music ? I’m so sick of the attempted “indoctrination” of audiences that attend these concerts. There were young Jewish children in your audience last evening. How do you think they felt hearing these rants about Palestine ? It’s completely uncalled for. As a fan, I am prepared to stop attending concerts for good if this deplorable behavior continues. I will merely listen to the music I like on XM Satellite radio. What’s right is right !! What do you think about this @israeliamerican ? America is a free country. We are free to speak our minds. Maybe Macklemore thinks he is free to spread his propaganda and lies ? I am also free to spend my hard earned money how I see fit, and it won’t be on any more WOKE artists. You’re better than this, Ed Sheeran. Do what’s right here.

moments.title: New GTA 6 map details (previews): - Once you unlock free roam after some missions, you can go anywhere on the map without barriers or restrictions - The map is an island (Leonida) and doesn’t have a panhandle - It’s 2x t
moments.selftext: New GTA 6 map details (previews): - Once you unlock free roam after some missions, you can go anywhere on the map without barriers or restrictions - The map is an island (Leonida) and doesn’t have a panhandle - It’s 2x the size of GTA5 and 3x the playable area of RDR2 - Vice City is double the size of Los Santos - The built-up area outside Vice City is 11 times bigger than the built-up area outside Los Santos - The map is dense, with 5 counties and approximately 10 cities/towns - There are multiple islands, and underwater exploration will feature diving equipment, shipwrecks and treasures - The map in the pause menu is very detailed with satellite 3D imagery - It helps you to plan a heist, as it shows buildings, gang bases, stores…etc in 3D, the loot value and the entry and exit - When the map is zoomed out, you only see the main roads and highways, but the more you zoom in, more roads and alleys appear - Rockstar’s goal is to make as many enterable buildings (there are hundreds of interiors) - Areas on the map won’t be fully visible until you explore them (fog of war) - There are many ways to fast travel around the map using public transport such as buses, trains, taxis, RydeMe app (Uber), Metromover and you can either skip the trip or talk with passenger NPCs and have full conversations or listen to the radio - You can buy as many garages around the map but you can’t buy safe houses (Jason & Lucia’s house changes throughout the story because they’re on the run) - Mission waypoints on the map are pink, custom ones are cyan -Mount Kalaga located in the northern part is the highest point in the map - You’ll be able to see heat areas on the map (an area where you committed a crime before and police will be on the lookout for you there for some time, as they actually setup a perimeter around the crime scene) - There heat area is red and there’s an even larger area around it in lighter red -At 6 stars, the heat area becomes map-wide - Any building with a helipad on top will be enterable and you can explore its interior, go up either by stairs or using the elevator to reach the top floor without loading screens
